chunks.title: Clustering in Data Mining Explained _ Top Clustering Methods You MUST Know_

chunks.title: Clustering in Data Mining Explained _ Top Clustering Methods You MUST Know_

chunks.title: Clustering in Data Mining Explained _ Top Clustering Methods You MUST Know_
chunks.text: Actually, all this method is done through clustering.

chunks.title: Clustering in Data Mining Explained _ Top Clustering Methods You MUST Know_
chunks.text: Why is it done?

chunks.title: Clustering in Data Mining Explained _ Top Clustering Methods You MUST Know_
chunks.text: Because we have to identify the customers on the basis of this method and send them promotional messages.

chunks.title: Clustering in Data Mining Explained _ Top Clustering Methods You MUST Know_
chunks.text: So that based on their past purchases,

chunks.title: Clustering in Data Mining Explained _ Top Clustering Methods You MUST Know_

chunks.title: Clustering in Data Mining Explained _ Top Clustering Methods You MUST Know_
chunks.text: This is used a lot in sales and marketing.

chunks.title: Clustering in Data Mining Explained _ Top Clustering Methods You MUST Know_
chunks.text: That's why we have multiple types of methods in clustering.

chunks.title: Clustering in Data Mining Explained _ Top Clustering Methods You MUST Know_
chunks.text: The first one is partitioning method.

chunks.title: Clustering in Data Mining Explained _ Top Clustering Methods You MUST Know_
chunks.text: Partitioning method says that we divide the data set into K.

chunks.title: Clustering in Data Mining Explained _ Top Clustering Methods You MUST Know_
chunks.text: If you get any numerical value, then you will be given K value.

chunks.title: Clustering in Data Mining Explained _ Top Clustering Methods You MUST Know_
Clustering in Data Mining Explained _ Top Clustering Methods You MUST Know_

chunks.title: Clustering in Data Mining Explained _ Top Clustering Methods You MUST Know_
chunks.text: Like I gave you an example that you have to identify which are the customers who purchase on alternate days.

chunks.title: Clustering in Data Mining Explained _ Top Clustering Methods You MUST Know_
chunks.text: Which are the customers who purchase once in a month and which are the customers who purchase once in a year.

chunks.title: Clustering in Data Mining Explained _ Top Clustering Methods You MUST Know_
chunks.text: So, three clusters are formed here.

chunks.title: Clustering in Data Mining Explained _ Top Clustering Methods You MUST Know_
chunks.text: So, the value of K is 3.

chunks.title: Clustering in Data Mining Explained _ Top Clustering Methods You MUST Know_
chunks.text: Just like this.

chunks.title: Clustering in Data Mining Explained _ Top Clustering Methods You MUST Know_
chunks.text: So, you have to divide the clusters where each partition represents a cluster.

chunks.title: Clustering in Data Mining Explained _ Top Clustering Methods You MUST Know_
chunks.text: Every partition is a cluster.

chunks.title: Clustering in Data Mining Explained _ Top Clustering Methods You MUST Know_
chunks.text: That's why it is called partition based.

chunks.title: Clustering in Data Mining Explained _ Top Clustering Methods You MUST Know_
chunks.text: And in partition based, you can ask from anywhere in any college or university exam or interview.
